```python
import cyclopts

app = cyclopts.App(name="fileman")

def upload(path: str):
    """Upload a file."""
    print(f"Would upload: {path}")

def download(url: str, *, dest: str):
    """Download from URL to destination."""
    print(f"URL: {url}")
    print(f"Destination: {dest}")

app.register(upload)
app.register(download)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    app()
```
